acceptance_criteria.description: GET /api/notes returns {'notes': [{id, title, created_at}]} ordered by created_at desc with an integration test in backend/tests/integration/
NotesPage fetches the list through a new fetchNotes of frontend/src/api/client.ts and renders titles, using the EmptyState pattern from @small/ui when the list is empty
App.tsx links to the new page and a component test follows HealthPage.test.tsx patterns

architectural_constraints: Follow the existing patterns and test style of the touched modules
No new dependencies without an explicit operator decision
Depends only on the current schema: do not wait for or touch the body column
